title: Stormy sea (28107075509).jpg
author: Mike McBey
description: The fury of storms from the Atlantic Ocean sometimes impact on the Orkney Islands, at the top of Scotland. Field Marshal Horatio Herbert Kitchener, 1st Earl Kitchener, a prominent British Army officer and colonial administrator was killed near here on 5 June 1916.
